problem_statement: Provisioning queue run aborts when the quota policy service times out. Last night's drain of the restricted-region queue stopped at the first request whose quota policy lookup timed out: `ProvisioningError` (caused by `PolicyServiceTimeout`) escaped from `process_queue` and every request behind it was left unprocessed. One slow policy lookup should not take down the whole run. Please make `process_queue` finish cleanly when the policy service times out so the remaining requests are still handled.

`process_queue` aborts the whole provisioning queue run if the quota policy service times out. During last night's drain of the restricted-region queue, processing halted at the first request whose quota policy lookup timed out: a `ProvisioningError` (caused by `PolicyServiceTimeout`) propagated out of `process_queue`, leaving every request after it unprocessed. A single slow policy lookup shouldn't bring down the entire run. Please change `process_queue` so it completes cleanly when the policy service times out and the remaining requests still get handled.

Quota policy service timeout kills the provisioning queue run. When we drained the restricted-region queue last night, the run stopped at the first request where the quota policy lookup timed out. `ProvisioningError` (caused by `PolicyServiceTimeout`) escaped `process_queue`, and all requests queued behind that one were never processed. One slow policy lookup shouldn't take out the entire run. Requested: `process_queue` should finish cleanly on a policy service timeout so the rest of the requests are still handled.

A timeout from the quota policy service causes the provisioning queue run to abort. Last night, while draining the restricted-region queue, the run stopped on the first request whose quota policy lookup timed out — `ProvisioningError` (caused by `PolicyServiceTimeout`) was raised out of `process_queue`, and every request after it went unprocessed. The whole run shouldn't fail because of one slow policy lookup. Please make `process_queue` finish cleanly when the policy service times out, so that the remaining requests are still processed.
